official.explanation: The chest X-ray findings from Figure 1a show a hyperlucent left lung with bronchiectasis, consistent with Mac-Leod syndrome. The mass identified in Figure 1b corresponds to an anterior mediastinal mass that could cause tracheobronchial compression, aligning with the presence of a bronchogenic cyst. These findings explain the recurrent bronchial pneumonia and defective thorax development due to the compression and compromised lung development/function.
